gateResults.evidence: The final Release owning-repository suite completed across 21 projects with 1,650 total tests, 1,616 passed, 0 failed and 34 classified skips; the focused Search suite and Search build also passed.
The separate review approved the twelve explicit friction regressions, answer-free A01-A40 holdout boundary, seed commitment and external-runner release-blocker record.
Three focused tests validate regression references, empty observations, exact holdout coverage, answer absence and pinned source hashes; the full Search suite and five semantic harnesses also passed.
The holdout descriptor pins the benchmark and neutral protocol bytes, while the regression catalog preserves source/result/completeness/security boundaries without claiming runtime or agent behavior.

knownLimitations: No fresh-context agent runner is available in this checkout. Fresh task-subset trials, observed-friction measurements, target first-success and repair rates, token comparisons and empirical confidence intervals remain unexecuted and are an explicit release blocker.
The holdout seed material is external-runner-only and the committed seed hash is a boundary commitment, not a reproducibility claim until the authorized runner reveals it after trial isolation.
The selected regressions are derived from planned first-attempt probes, not observed agent failures; observations remain empty by design.
Platform-dependent unreadable and invalid-encoding behavior requires evidence from the platform on which future trials run.
No package was published, pushed, released or installed, and no sibling repository was edited.
